card.name: Where and when to apply topical products
card.fires_on: The word 'the' or 'on' right after 'apply ... to/on', and 'evening' in 'once daily in the evening', in skin-product directions. Also 'Force' in air force names.

modes.label: Apply to the site
modes.description: 'the' or 'on' after apply-to wording, just before the body area or skin site.
modes.example: Apply a new patch to<< the>> upper outer arm, abdomen, buttock

modes.label: In the evening
modes.description: 'evening' ending 'once daily in the' in gel directions.
modes.example: (clindamycin phosphate and benzoyl peroxide) Gel, 1.2%/5% to the face once daily, in the<< evening>>.

modes.label: Air Force names
modes.description: 'Force' in lists of air forces, a minor side pattern.
modes.example: First flight||27 July 1972| |Introduction||9 January 1976| |Primary users||United States Air<< Force>> Japan Air Self-Defense Force
